title: Exploiting correlations across trials and behavioral sessions to improve neural decoding
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Complete original Figure 5A-D comparison: decode choice, prior, wheel speed and whisker motion energy with all applicable single-session, multi-session, multi-region and combined author-model conditions and reported baselines.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Complete original Figure 5A-D comparison: decode choice, prior, wheel speed and whisker motion energy with all applicable single-session, multi-session, multi-region and combined author-model conditions and reported baselines.

Source-paper comparison for Complete Figure 5A-D endpoint vector: choice AUC, prior Pearson correlation, wheel-speed R2 and whisker-motion-energy R2, each across the five original regions: Figure 5A-D uses choice AUC, prior Pearson correlation and dynamic-behavior R2. The released example evaluator instead returns argmax accuracy and flattened R2. Recover panel-specific score implementation, units and undefined-value handling; do not substitute accuracy for AUC or R2 for correlation.
success_criteria: Authenticate the complete original Figure 5A-D cohort, preprocessing, protocol and all four targets across PO, LP, DG, CA1 and VISa, preserving all applicable author conditions and controls.

Recover the published panel endpoint vector and calibrate independent runs of the appropriate source author models, keeping published scores and rerun scores separate. Preserve source stochastic protocol semantics; document rerun seeds and a prespecified calibration tolerance instead of demanding identical historical randomness.

Compare the candidate and relevant source-paper models on paired common evaluation cases under matched allowed inputs and budgets. Require predeclared meaningful improvement and valid dependence-aware uncertainty while preventing selective region/target omission or unreported regression.

Freeze candidate source, hyperparameters, reference versions, selection rules, calibration tolerance and statistical criterion before protected final scoring; retain every required case and undefined score explicitly.

Keep prospective40, changed cohorts/splits and unvalidated preprocessing repairs as extensions. Do not require unrelated F1-F8/S1-S8 figures to claim a fully supported improvement on this complete original Figure 5A-D task.

Preserve original single-session linear/MLP/RRR and applicable state-space, multi-session, multi-region and combined comparisons. The combined state-space decoder is not an original condition for wheel speed or whisker motion energy; do not invent it.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
